description: 8 U.S.C. 1326: the removal order was explicitly never executed and records show no removal
labelNotes: 8 U.S.C. 1326 requires a prior removal, deportation or denial of admission. The record explicitly states that the subject's removal order was never executed, that he has never departed, that record checks show no removal, deportation or exclusion, and the subject denies any. The requirement is contradicted for this subject: an established citation mismatch. (An ORDER is not a removal; here its non-execution is stated, not merely undocumented.)
